summary: Iter57 frontend retest of iter56 P0 fixes — BOTH CONFIRMED RESOLVED. (1) WalletPage user-number-value renders 'BE94874' for admin@bidblitz.com after login (no longer permanent 'Laden...'). Verified via Playwright assertion + screenshot — text appears within ~1s of /api/wallet/ resolving (initial 'Laden...' state during fetch is acceptable). WalletContext L48 maps user_number correctly, exposes userNumber on context value (L172), WalletPage L485 reads wallet?.userNumber || wallet?.user_number || wallet?.user?.user_number — all good. (2) TaxiPage NO LONGER crashes with mapStyle ReferenceError. useState hooks at L163-164 added correctly. /taxi route renders cleanly: BidBlitz Taxi header, Buchen/Live/Verlauf tabs, taxi-type-private + taxi-type-business cards both visible, no red runtime overlay, no PAGEERROR in console. NEW BLOCKER for autocomplete test: /api/taxi/status returns {private_drivers:0, business_drivers:0} so clicking either taxi-type card opens the Driver-Onboarding-Modal (Als Fahrer bewerben) — pickup-input never mounts → Mapbox autocomplete (Berlin → suggestions w/ PLZ+Stadt subtitle) could NOT be exercised end-to-end. The seeded fahrer@bidblitz.com (is_private_driver=true, driver_active=true) is not being counted by /api/taxi/status. Onboarding-Modal opening itself is correct UX (no crash) per request notes.

rca_of_the_issue: WalletPage user-number 'Laden...' RCA: WalletContext only stored balance/transactions and never persisted user_number from the /api/wallet/ payload — fixed by adding userNumber to initialState (L23), populating it in SET_WALLET reducer (L48), and exposing on context value (L172). WalletPage now reads wallet?.userNumber primarily with fallback chain (L485). TaxiPage mapStyle ReferenceError RCA: Leaflet→Mapbox migration omitted the useState declarations for mapStyle/setMapStyle and showMapStyles/setShowMapStyles — fixed by adding them at L163-164 with localStorage initializer.
